Research provenance: Holas P, Szewczuk J, Rusanowska M et al. Psychiatria Polska 58(4):637-651; published 2024-08-31; DOI 10.12740/PP/172115. Polish SCS-SF translated/adapted with n596 adults ages 18-50, n47 retest one month, CFA and convergent measures; one-factor global score.

RU form: No independently validated RU form established in cited Polish study.
ES form: No independently validated ES form established in cited Polish study.
Other translations: PL-PL Polish 12-item short respondent form independently psychometrically studied n596; n47 retest. One-factor structure, not six proven subscale scores.
Target population: Polish general population adults aged 18-50; 596 baseline, 47 repeat after one month.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Commercial digital right to Neff original 12 items and Holas translated Polish wording not established; journal publication/PDF availability does not grant SaaS license. Scales / measured domains (EN): Self-kindness (3); Self-judgment (3); Common humanity (3); Isolation (3); Mindfulness (3); Over-identification (2); six-factor model preferred; two-factor borderline fit.
Research provenance: Barłóg M, Kwissa-Gajewska Z. Mindfulness 17:1215–1226, published 2026-03-02; DOI 10.1007/s12671-026-02799-6. Polish SCS-Y-PL study n415 pupils aged 10–16, n72 retest at three weeks; CFA/ESEM favor six factors, two-factor borderline, some items with cross-loadings.
DB locales: No identical source-qualified Polish edition key in Holistic House published assessment_versions 2026-10-28 (149 keys/234 locales, EN154 RU80 ES0).
EN form: Original SCS-Y EN 17-item instrument is already indexed as scs-y-17; Polish study is not new EN-language respondent validation.
RU form: No independently validated Russian adolescent form established in cited article.
ES form: No independently validated Spanish adolescent form established in cited article.
Other translations: PL-PL independently evaluated youth Polish translation, school cohort n415, three-week retest n72; six factor best fit with target-loading caveats; distinct from adult Polish full/short.
Target population: Nonclinical schoolchildren aged 10–16 in Poland; N415, repeat N72. Original youth author form targets early adolescents; generalization beyond sampled schooling/age untested.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Springer article displays open access and CC BY-NC-ND metadata; original Neff youth item text and Polish translation commercial digital permissions must be obtained separately. No minors' assessment without consent/assent, safeguarding, privacy and practitioner review.
Verification notes / safety gate: RESEARCH ONLY. Do not treat SCS-Y self-compassion as diagnostic depression screening; bifactor models identification problems, some cross-loadings; permissions, precise scoring and child protection required before any clinical or commercial deployment.
